items.title: 17.7.2 Quicklime from Limestone (choone ke pathar se quicklime) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 17.7.2 with Figure 17.5, printed page 10.

blocks.text: Yeh Group 2 ke compound calcium carbonate (limestone, choone ka pathar) se juda sab se purana aur basic industrial process (tareeqa) hai. Quicklime, yani calcium oxide, bohat zaroori chemical hai jo construction (cement, mortar), agriculture (zaraat, mitti ka ilaaj), metallurgy (metals nikalne ka kaam) aur kai chemical industries mein istemal hota hai. Limestone qudrati taur par bohat milne wala sedimentary pathar hai jo zyada tar calcium carbonate se bana hai. Quicklime banane ke liye limestone ko ek bohat garam bhatti ("lime kiln") mein bohat zyada temperature (aam taur par 900-1000 °C) tak garam kiya jata hai. Is process (amal) ko calcination ya thermal decomposition kehte hain (Figure 17.5).

Modern (jadeed) lime kilns mein saman ko reaction ke temperature par ghoomti hui garam gases se garam kiya jata hai. Band bartan mein yeh reaction reversible hai (ulta bhi chal sakta hai), lekin CO₂ ko lagataar bahar nikal kar ise tez kiya jata hai.
CO₂ nikalne se equilibrium daen taraf (products ki taraf) khisak jata hai, aur zyada product (CaO) jaldi banta hai.

blocks.alt: Patthar ki lime kiln (bhatti) ka kata hua manzar. Pisa hua choone ka pathar (CaCO3) gaari se chimney ke oopar daala jata hai (INPUT). Jalne wale hisse mein, 900-1000 C par, baen se fuel burner aur daen se coal aur natural gas aati hai. Neeche jaali (grate) par CaO jama hota hai, neeche se teer oopar jate hain, aur CaO gaari mein bahar nikalta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 17.5: CaCO3 ke reaction se lime (CaO) banta hai jis ke bohat se istemal hain (kitab ki Figure 17.5 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki tasveer mein bhatti ke garam hisse par 600 °C aur 300 °C likha hai, lekin kitab ka apna text 900-1000 °C kehta hai aur Table 17.3 ke mutabiq CaCO₃ 900 °C par toot'ta hai. Sahi: 900-1000 °C. Tasveer mein burner par 'FIEAL TOAL' aur 'Natural GAs' ghalat chhapa hai; sahi 'Fuel' aur 'Natural Gas' hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Pathar upar se dala jata hai (INPUT) aur neeche aata hai. Garam hisse mein CaCO₃ → CaO + CO₂ hota hai. Neeche se CaO nikal liya jata hai aur CO₂ garam gases ke saath upar nikal jati hai; isi liye reaction ulta nahi chal pata.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke CO₂ nikalne se reaction 'tez' hota hai. Asal baat yeh hai ke CO₂ nikalne se equilibrium products ki taraf chala jata hai, is liye CaO ziyada banta hai (yield barhti hai) aur reaction ruk kar wapas nahi palatta.

blocks.prompt: Lime kiln se carbon dioxide lagataar kyun nikali jati hai?
blocks.explanation: CaCO₃ ⇌ CaO + CO₂ reversible hai. CO₂ (product) nikalne se equilibrium daen taraf jata hai, is liye zyada limestone toot'ta hai aur zyada quicklime milta hai.
